## Project Overview

The **SD4SP Project** focuses on the mechanisms of stratosphere-troposphere coupling. Particularly the impacts of ENSO and the QBO over the  [North Atlantic - European (NAE)](nae.html) region through their teleconnection via the stratospehere. The aim of SD4SP is to identify this mechanims to improve their representation in climate models.

### Theoretical Framework

The figure below summarizes the coupling processes analyzed in this project, considering also the effect of of Stratospheric Sudden Warming (SSW) and Strong Polar Vortex (SPV) events.
